note: E1: the 2025 report says the GRESB 5 Star rating was attained for the sixth consecutive year since inaugural participation in 2020 (2020-2025), so Suntec REIT took part in the 2025 assessment; E3/E6 renew participation for 2026 as the recurring pattern
E5: FY2021 electricity consumption 61 kWh per square foot against 68 in FY2020, so lower; E6 renews the same target for FY2022

E1-E2; E8-E9; E12: the HQ solar installation is reported operational, but in the deadline year the extension of installation services to clients is still stated as an aim (we aim to broaden our portfolio of green services offered to clients and partners) with no report that such services were offered; the 2025 report names other emerging areas (submarine cables, geotechnical, offshore renewables), not installation services

E1; E3; E5: the FY2023 report says a more comprehensive understanding of the emissions baseline was achieved by disclosing four Scope 3 categories (52,163 tCO2e), mirroring the promise wording; the clause about informing the reduction strategy is only partly evidenced (E7: hotspots identified, decarbonisation strategies still to be considered)
E3: no significant incidents of non-compliance with laws and regulations in the social and economic area in FY2024; E7 and E10 report the same for environmental and health-and-safety compliance
E3; E8; E10: the 2025 report says youth football training reached 68 provinces, short of all 77, and E8 still lists expansion to all 77 provinces as a target; the 2024 report (E1) had 70 provinces

E6; E8; E10: FY2022 water (36,062 vs 161,864 m3) and waste (734 vs 886 t) fell against FY2021 only, with no comparison to the 2017 baseline and no energy figure; the figures cover vessels and shipyards while E10 restates the target as 2% per annum for office premises, so it may not be the same target; E13-E15 are FY2023 results and a re-formulation to intensity, not the deadline year
E6-E7: all 12 properties in the portfolio remain green certified as of FY2024

E7: properties participated in over 70 corporate and social responsibility activities in FY2023, above 15; E5 says the FY2023 target was achieved; E11-E12 show the company counts these activities against this target
E2; E7: FY2023 performance table marks zero reported incidents of corruption as Met

E7-E9: the target is a 25% reduction in water withdrawal from the 2020 level by 2025; E8 says the five-year 25% target was not met and was delayed, E9 reports a 15% reduction; the promise sentence itself carries no quantity, the extracted 25% comes from later restatements
E2: average 46 training hours per employee in FY2023, above the 26-hour target

E3; E5-E9; E12: Beta Young project outcomes are reported (179 entrepreneurs, graduate shares, eleven generations) but nothing says a community or network of all batches was built; E10's ASEAN networking platform is a different initiative

E6; E8: the referent of 'trend of conservation' cannot be identified from the promise; FY2022 lists energy and water conservation measures and renews the aim to maintain strong environmental performance, but no figure shows the conservation trend continued; E3 notes emissions were disclosed for the first time

E5; E9-E10: the 2025 report gives a current 20 MWp solar capacity across Batamindo and Bintan with no phase breakdown, so completion of the 15.5 MWp Phase 2 at Batamindo cannot be told; E9 resets the roadmap to 40 MWp by 2030, a different aggregate target rather than this phase
